article.story: NEW ROCHELLE, N.Y. -- — Bol Agu’s 13 points helped Fairleigh Dickinson fend off Iona 49-46 on Monday. Agu also contributed eight rebounds for the Knights (4-3). Travis Torain scored 10 points and grabbed five rebounds. David Jevtic had nine points. Kevon Vanderhorst finished with 11 points and three blocks for the Gaels (3-5). Iona also got eight points and seven rebounds each from Keyshawn Mitchell and Ore Odutayo. Up next: Fairleigh Dickinson plays VSU-Randolph at home on Wednesday, and Iona visits Bryant on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
